note: Text one player sends the others during a match. Messages players exchange outside a match do not travel on this connection at all.

revisions.note: A line of chat. A client sends one as its player says something, and shows one a server sends in its chat box.

fields.name: speaker
fields.note: The client id the line is from. A client sends its own. From a server, a client shows the line with the name and champion of the player holding that client id, coloured for their side, and with no name for a client id nobody holds; 4294967295 shows the line as said to everyone with no name, less its first three bytes.

fields.name: audience
fields.note: 1 for the speaker's side alone, which a client shows without a tag; any other value from a server is shown tagged as said to everyone. A client sends 0 where its player began the line with the all-chat prefix, which it leaves out of the text, and 1 otherwise.

fields.name: textLength
fields.note: The length of the text in bytes, without the byte that ends it. Its value changes nothing a client does.

fields.name: text
fields.note: The line; a client reads it up to the zero byte that ends it.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the sender.

fields.name: netId
fields.note: The entity a receiving end attributes the text to where the seat does not name one. Where the seat names a speaker, that is what a receiving end uses instead.

fields.name: localized
fields.note: Whether the text is a phrase to show as it stands, or a key naming one the receiving end looks up and fills in from the parameters. Both ends send it clear.

fields.name: audience
fields.note: Who the message reaches.
